## Why visit

One of the most distinctive experiences in the whole catchment: drink cider where the apples are grown and pressed. The barn and orchard setting offer a direct connection with local production that a city pub cannot reproduce. CAMRA records tasting boards, and the farm describes an onsite café with homemade cakes and wood-fired pizza. Give this a weekend daylight slot if cider is a major priority. It needs more deliberate transport planning than a central bar, but can be paired with Altrincham’s cask pubs for a day with real variety.

## Beer

Cider-led rather than a cask-ale destination. CAMRA reports local canned beer; do not expect hand-pulled ale.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** Explicit CAMRA real-cider listing; Trafford & Hulme’s Cider Pub of the Year 2026. Ask which estate ciders are open for tasting.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).
